claims.text: The resort is tucked away within the medieval village of Megalohori and evolved from a 400-year-old wine cellar and a 100-year-old mansion.

findings.quote: Tucked away within the medieval village of Megalohori, the enchanting Vedema a Luxury Collection Resort has evolved from a 400 year old wine cellar and a 100 year old mansion

claims.text: The resort is built around the 400-year-old winery at the heart of the property and resembles a traditional fortified Greek village.

findings.quote: Inspired by and built around the 400-year-old winery that dominates the heart of the property, the resort resembles a traditional fortified Greek village

claims.text: The resort sits on a more than 500-year-old vineyard overlooking Megalohori and was built in 1993.

findings.quote: Situated on a more than 500-year-old vineyard overlooking the medieval village of Megalohori, the resort was built in 1993

claims.text: Architect Mary Kavagia and interior designers Yiannis Tseklenis and Aggelos Aggelopoulos created the resort as a traditional fortified Greek village.

findings.quote: He then commissioned renowned architect Mary Kavagia and interior designers Yiannis Tseklenis and Aggelos Aggelopoulos to create a traditional fortified Greek village

claims.text: The name Vedema is the Venetian translation for 'harvest'.

findings.quote: its name, Vedema, is the direct Venetian translation for 'harvest.'

claims.text: The vineyards around the hotel produce their own vintage, which guests can taste in the Canava Wine Bar.

findings.quote: Even today, the vineyards that surround the hotel are nurtured to produce their own special vintage, available for guests to taste in the Canava Wine Bar.

claims.text: Interiors combine the angular lines of Cycladic architecture with island-sourced antique furnishings.

findings.quote: Integrating the fresh angular lines of Cycladic architecture with island-sourced antique furnishings

claims.text: In all rooms, wooden doors open to a private terrace or patio overlooking the resort gardens.

findings.quote: In all rooms, characteristic wooden doors open to a private terrace or patio that overlooks the enchanting resort gardens.

claims.text: Elios Spa is set in a 100-year-old wine cellar.

findings.quote:
Elios Spa

Our fully equipped spa is located in an enchanting 100-year-old wine cellar.

claims.text: Elios Spa offers therapeutic massages, facials and body treatments.

findings.quote: Therapeutic massages, facials and body treatments soothe and rejuvenate.

claims.text: Alati Restaurant is set in the 400-year-old winery cave with stone walls.

findings.quote: Alati Restaurant has evolved from the 400-year-old winery cave, made from distinctive stone walls

claims.text: The Kinship Program offers families hands-on experiences rooted in Santorini's traditions.

findings.quote: Our Kinship Program invites families to discover Santorini together through hands-on experiences that celebrate connection, creativity, and the island’s living traditions.

claims.text: All suites and villas have their own terraces, and many have jacuzzis or private pools.

findings.quote: All suites and villas feature their own terraces and many come with jacuzzis or private pools

claims.text: The Nafsika Estate has caldera and sea views, a private pool and a whirlpool.

findings.quote: Estate, Caldera view, Sea view, Private pool, Whirlpool

claims.text: The sunset wine ceremony in the Canava Wine Bar is a tasting of 6 indigenous wines with Greek cheeses and crackers.

findings.quote: The old setting of the Canava Wine Bar serves as a delightful backdrop for our sunset wine ceremony. The unforgettable tasting of 6 exquisite indigenous wines with an excellent variety of Greek cheeses and crackers

claims.text: The concierge arranges daily excursions to the black, red and white beaches by private sailboat.

findings.quote: our concierge is on-hand to help organize the day’s activities
Daily excursions to black, red and white beaches via private sailboats

claims.text: Guests can host a picnic on the resort's private beach.

findings.quote: host a romantic picnic on the resort’s private beach

claims.text: The swimming pool is not heated.

findings.quote: The temperature of our non-heated pool ensures a cooling, rejuvenating dip

claims.text: Prive Dining's five- or seven-course degustation menus are available with an advance booking.

findings.quote: Privé Dining offers the option, with an advance booking, for guests to savor, five- or seven-course degustation menus that highlight the myriad flavours of Santorini.
